transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… it’s the eating. What scares me most is once I start, it feels like my hands just keep reaching for more, even while I’m telling myself, “Tom, stop this right now.”
Can you tell me more about those times when you’re eating—do you feel like you can’t stop or control how much you eat once you start?
Yeah… once I start, it’s like I can’t quite get hold of it. My hands just keep going back for more, even when I’m telling myself to stop. It scares me.
When you’re eating like this, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or try to burn off the calories later with exercise?

Yeah… sometimes. I don’t like saying it, but after I’ve eaten too much I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. And… I’ve taken laxatives too, because I get scared the food will just stay in me.
